name: lw3-mcp
description: Discover and control Lightware devices over the LW3 protocol

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Discover Lightware devices on the local network using mDNS

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect to a Lightware device using LW3 protocol

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect from the current Lightware device

tools.name: GET
tools.description: Read a property value from the connected Lightware device

tools.name: SET
tools.description: Set a property value on the connected Lightware device

tools.name: GETALL
tools.description: Get all child nodes, properties and methods of a node

tools.name: GETROOT
tools.description: Get root structure of the device (equivalent to GETALL /V1/*)

tools.name: CALL
tools.description: Execute a method on the connected Lightware device

tools.name: MAN
tools.description: Get manual/documentation for a property or method

tools.name: xpoint
tools.description: Show the video crosspoint: which source is routed to each destination, and which sources each destination can switch to
